title: The 4 Best Massage Guns Under $100
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for massage guns under $100, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at massage guns under $100 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: RENPHO Active Massage Gun
products.blurb: Key specs: 5 speed settings, 5 interchangeable heads, Carry case included.
strengths: Five heads included is more than most competitors bundle at this price
limitations: Stall force is modest compared with premium models
Battery life shorter than higher-priced competitors
Plastic build feels basic, though functional

products.name: TOLOCO Massage Gun
products.blurb: Key specs: 10 massage heads, Silent brushless motor, Multiple speed levels.
strengths: 10 heads bundled is unusually generous at this price
limitations: Motor noise picks up at higher speeds
Build quality trails the RENPHO and premium brands
Auto shut-off can interrupt a longer session

products.name: Hyperice Hypervolt Go 2
products.blurb: Key specs: 1.5 lb compact body, 40W brushless motor, 3 speeds.
strengths: A recognized recovery brand name at close to budget pricing
Compact size is easy to justify even at a slightly higher price
limitations: Only 3 speeds versus 5 on the cheaper picks here
Lower stall force than dedicated deep-tissue guns

products.name: Bob and Brad C2 Massage Gun
limitations: Charger brick not included on some versions
Not as deep as pro guns

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
